why: NOT A SWARM DECK. The 400-game Forge run killed that thesis: composite won 31/400 against the champion's 50/400, interval on the difference excluding zero, and the mechanism was one number -- combat damage dealt to players fell 29.07 to 18.20 because 1/1 tokens do not connect against real blockers. So the tokens stop being the clock and become FUEL. OUT go the arrival-damage payoffs that pay 1-2 per 1/1 (Impact Tremors, Witty Roastmaster, Warleader's Call, Corpse Knight, Mirkwood Bats, Purphoros) and the go-wide combat payoffs. IN come free sacrifice outlets (Viscera Seer, Ashnod's Altar, Altar of Dementia), the dig they feed (Liliana Dreadhorde General draws on every creature death; Bloodtracker; High-Society Hunter), and the payoffs that eat tokens and get big: Yahenni and Immersturm Predator turn a token into INDESTRUCTIBLE, Vish Kal turns one into +X/+X and then into removal, Bloodflow Connoisseur is the cheap version. Crossway Troublemakers gives every attacking Vampire deathtouch AND lifelink, which is what makes a board of any size unprofitable to block. Altar of Dementia mills OPPONENTS, which grows The Haunt of Hightower and the Nighthawk Scavenger already in the 99 -- self-mill would bury the payoffs, opponent-mill feeds them. THE GOLDFISH IS NOT THE ARBITER HERE and is expected to under-rate this: it has no blockers, so it rewards exactly the wide board the real table just ate. Forge decides.

proposal.why: The only one of six branches that beats the checked-in list on anything at a real table. 400 Forge games per arm against the pilot's own pod at one seed: +6.91 combat damage [0.07, 13.76] and +0.46 casts [0.01, 0.92], both excluding zero. It pays 1.17 drain for that, which is also real and six times smaller. Win rate 0.142 against 0.125 is NOT resolvable and is not claimed. Selected over composite, drain-engine, mana-recovery and two bloodline revisions after every arm was re-derived under the corrected metrics.
